evidence.claim: The building has a metal-clad gabled roof and stone foundation.

evidence.claim: Outside are an overshot metal wheel in a stone wheel well and remnants of the headrace.

flags: The cached List of Virginia Byways omits its route table. It supports the general designation program only, not this corridor’s designation or its rationale. Omitted the current assertion that Beech Grove Road and Rockfish River Road belong to the same byway, and their connections, because those are not recoverable from the cache.

The cache explains the numbered highway’s geography but not its construction or scenic-byway campaign. The shorter overview substitutes the documented preservation of land beside the road, clearly separate from road-building history; no drive time or corridor mileage is supplied.

Crabtree Falls height descriptions mix total cascade drop, vertical drop and free fall. Retained only five major cascades and the source-qualified tallest-cascade height; omitted total-height and regional-record claims.

Tyro Mill machinery is documented, but no cache page establishes public access or current operation. No entry or demonstration is promised. The source’s traditional identification of the log house is preserved.

Camille is described without the cached precise rainfall and death totals, which lack underlying weather-service or historical records here. The narrative avoids the current draft’s sleeping-resident scene while retaining the supported event and forty-home village size.

The falls moment remains short to avoid inflating limited natural-feature evidence. No trail distance is cached; the retained short walk kind should not be read as a promise that reaching the upper falls is a short walk.
